definition: Kilo Code is an open-source artificial intelligence coding agent for software development.
details: It can generate and modify source code, execute commands, debug software, and perform development tasks from natural language instructions. Kilo Code is model-agnostic and can work with hundreds of large language models rather than being tied to a single AI provider. The software is available as an extension for Visual Studio Code and JetBrains integrated development environments, through a command-line interface, and through cloud-based agents. Kilo Code was acquired by Anaconda in July 2026.
